subject: Request: temporary P1/P2 on-call carve-out for APAC maintenance window
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@orchidpay.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kenji Sato <ksato@orchidpay.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 22:12:00 +0900
Subject: Planned APAC maintenance - request for temporary P1/P2 carve-out

Sergio,

Heads up — OrchidPay is planning a platform maintenance in APAC on June 28 from 01:00–04:00 JST. During that window we'll be performing database upgrades that will cause brief connectivity blips for our integration (estimated 8–12 minutes total across the window).

Our security and compliance teams asked whether Redwood can provide a temporary adjustment to the support response SLA for P1/P2 incidents originating from APAC during that maintenance window — specifically, a carve-out so that the normal P1 15-minute human response and P2 60-minute response do not trigger incident credits while we perform the work. We understand this is an exception request and want to be explicit about scope:
- Window: 2026-06-28 01:00–04:00 JST
- Affected endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings on region apac-1
- Expected impact: short, intermittent connection failures (not full region outage)

Could you confirm if Redwood can approve this, and if so what the escalation path will be if the impact is broader than anticipated? We appreciate a short written agreement and any operational mitigations you can provide (fallback routing, temporary increased retry headers, etc.).

I'll attach our maintenance plan and can loop legal if needed. Please let me know by EOD Wednesday APAC.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Integrations, OrchidPay
olivia.chen@orchidpay.com
+65 8123 4455

Attachments: apac-maintenance-plan.pdf
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@orchidpay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kenji Sato <ksato@orchidpay.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:03:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Planned APAC maintenance - request for temporary P1/P2 carve-out

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and the clear scope. We can evaluate a temporary carve-out provided a few operational safeguards are in place. Outline of what we need from OrchidPay to proceed: 

1) Final maintenance MOP (detailed steps + rollback) — please attach.
2) A confirmed outage window in ISO with timezone and a single point of contact reachable during the window.
3) Commitment that traffic patterns will be monitored on your side and that you'll notify us immediately if the impact exceeds brief connectivity blips.

From Redwood's side, here's what we can offer for that window: 
- Temporary SLA carve-out limited to stated endpoints and time range (we'll capture this in a short amendment).
- A documented escalation path: first contact — Redwood on-call (P1) via pager; secondary — Grace O'Connor (engineering manager); tertiary — me.
- Automated fallback: we'll enable region failover to apac-2 if error rates cross 5% sustained for >3m, and we will raise a high-priority bridge if we detect increased token error rates.

Can you share the MOP and the SPOC? If we get those by EOD Wednesday APAC I'll draft a one-paragraph SLA amendment and route it for quick sign-off.

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Sr. Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+61 412 555 009

Attachments: none
From: Kenji Sato <ksato@orchidpay.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@orchidpay.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:18:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Planned APAC maintenance - request for temporary P1/P2 carve-out

Thanks for the quick reply, Sergio. Attaching the MOP now (apac_maintenance_mop.pdf) and confirming our SPOC during the window:
- Name: Kenji Sato (Platform Ops)
- Mobile: +81 90 1234 5678
- Email: ksato@orchidpay.com

A few clarifications from OrchidPay: 
- If Redwood triggers the apac-2 failover, will that produce a distinct incident ticket for OrchidPay (we need correlated tickets for our audit trail)?
- We're requesting that while the carve-out is active, Redwood does not automatically issue credits for P1/P2. If the impact escalates to a region-wide outage, we will expect normal SLA handling.

Also, Kenji asked whether Redwood can provide the bridge link and on-call pager contact for the week of maintenance so we can add them to our runbook.

Best,
Kenji
Kenji Sato
Platform Ops Lead, OrchidPay
ksato@orchidpay.com

Attachments: apac_maintenance_mop.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@orchidpay.com>, Kenji Sato <ksato@orchidpay.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:05:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Planned APAC maintenance - request for temporary P1/P2 carve-out

Hi Olivia / Kenji — following Sergio's note, we have reviewed the MOP and confirm Redwood's operational commitments for the maintenance window: 

1) SLA amendment: Redwood will issue a temporary carve-out for the specified APAC window covering P1/P2 response credits for the stated endpoints. The carve-out is conditional on the MOP and the SPOC information provided in Kenji's email. A one-paragraph amendment will be attached (see sla_carveout_template.docx).

2) Escalation path and contacts (active during 2026-06-28 01:00–04:00 JST):
   - Redwood on-call (initial P1 contact): pager + bridge (pager: +1-650-555-1212, bridge: https://meet.redwood.ai/bridge/SUP-2143)
   - Grace O'Connor (engineering manager): grace.oconnor@redwood.ai / +1-650-555-2323
   - Sergio Alvarez (customer success): sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai / +61 412 555 009

3) Failover behavior: If we observe sustained >5% error rate for 3 consecutive minutes, we'll perform a controlled failover to apac-2 and open an incident (SUP-2143). That incident will be linked to your account and you'll receive a correlated ticket for audit purposes.

4) Credit policy: If impact escalates beyond the stated brief connectivity blips into a region-wide outage, normal SLA credit rules will apply. The carve-out only suspends automatic crediting for the narrow window/conditions described.

Next steps: I'll attach the draft amendment (sla_carveout_template.docx) and our internal bridge link. Please confirm acceptance by replying-all. Upon your confirmation, legal will send a simple signature request (DocuSign link).

Thanks — we'll also have a dedicated engineer monitoring your telemetry during the window.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Engineering Manager, Reliability — Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
+1-650-555-2323

Attachments: sla_carveout_template.docx
